prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: low-speed head-on collision in Katy, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1285; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving slowly through a parking area in Katy, Texas, when the other vehicle came straight toward me and we collided head-on. Neither of us was moving fast, but the impact was enough to jolt me forward and against the steering wheel. My left knee struck the dashboard, and I felt sharp pain almost immediately. I have described the events the same way each time I have spoken about them, whether to the other driver, the responding officer, or the adjuster. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating my own vehicle at the time. I have kept copies of my medical visits and will provide them on request. I am asking that this claim be reviewed so my knee treatment and vehicle repairs can be addressed.
